notes.title: Have You Played The Deadly Tower of Monsters?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time…

You know that age-old idea that games should be more like FILMS because films are ART, and games should be like ART too? Well, I think there’s a very good reason games shouldn’t be more like films, because then we’d have more games like The Deadly Tower of Monsters on our hands, which, frankly – *record scratch*

Sorry, everyone, Katharine from the future here, taking over with some director’s commentary of this Have You Played, because past Katharine was about to step in a big steaming gorilla turd and slam us with a giant lawsuit!

(more…)

notes.title: Deadly Tower leads nominations in Brasil's BIG Festival 2017
notes.notes:
The Deadly Tower of Monsters has been nominated in 4 categories for the upcoming [url=http://principal.bigfestival.com.br/2017/] BIG Festival 2017 [/url] (Latin America's largest game festival but open to the entire world).

Translated from Portuguese:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11026990/1c555770fbd91117894f72c8bf9890f2f9eba519.jpg[/img]
[url=http://br.ign.com/big-festival/48471/news/conheca-os-games-finalistas-do-big-festival-2017] IGN Brasil[/url]

DToM is nominated in the following categories:
-Best Game
-Best Art
-Best Sound
-Best Latin American Game

ACE Team is proud to be representing the region with our wacky Sci-Fi adventure. A big thanks to the organizers and to our fans for your continued support :)

notes.title: The Deadly Tower of Monsters Gets Survival Mode
notes.notes:
The Deadly Tower of Monsters [official site] features a hero named Dick Starspeed, so that’s one reason you should know it’s received a new Survival mode. ACE Team’s top-down action shooter is all about B-movie glitz from head to toe, so it shouldn’t come as any surprise that its new free mode borrows from that universe as well.

You also might not be surprised to hear that ACE Team was responsible for the gleefully bizarre Zeno Clash. Ah, that would probably explain everything about this game, then. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Deadly Tower of Monsters Now with 4-Player Co-op and Hard Mode!
notes.notes:
The newly added 4-player co-op mode has now come out of beta and is live for all players.

[url]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=635911740[/url]
Along with the addition of co-op, a new hard mode has also been included for players looking to make their trek up the tower more treacherous.

Here's some info regarding the nature of the co-op:

Q: Why is this local co-op only?
A: This was a crazy feature we added by toying around with the code which started out as something that the programmers did for fun. An online mode would require reprogramming an important part of the game and is not feasible. This isn't something that was meant to be a feature of the game.

Q: Will you ever add online?
A: No. This would require remaking a substantial part of the game's code. Local coop is much more simple.

Q: How does this affect the game's story / campaign / game mechanics?
A: The game wasn't designed or balanced with co-op in mind, so many things about the coop are just things that needed to be done in a specific way in order not to break the game entirely:
[list]
[*]Player 1 still controls the main camera.
[*]Other players get to play with the character that player 1 chooses.
[*]Player 1 chooses when you can aim down (due to the camera change) 
[*]Etc.
[/list]
There are several obvious limitations in the co-op's implementation (because the game was created strictly as a single-player experience), however the 4 player co-op is hilarious and extremely fun.

notes.title: Deadly Tower of Monsters 4 Player COOP Beta!
notes.notes:
Deadly Tower of Monsters 4 Player COOP Beta!

Hello everyone! Here at ACE Team we're always happy to come up with surprises and cool updates for our titles. Our latest crazy creation is adding 4 player local coop for The Deadly Tower of Monsters! :O

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=635911740

Given the complexity of this new update, we are first delivering the content as a Beta build, available to anyone who owns the game. Once the build has been found to be stable, we will pass it on to the "main branch" as part of the full game. The Beta build can easily be accessed by doing the following:

1) Select the game on Steam, right click and choose 'Properties'.
2) Go to the 'Betas' tab
3) Select the Beta from the Drop down list.
4) We recommend verifying the integrity of game cache after selecting the Beta, to make sure you download that branch. ('Local Files' tab -> 'Verify integrity of game cache').

*When launching the Beta, the game should appear as v1.04
**If you want to return to the regular branch, just choose 'None' in the 'Betas' tab

Q&A:

Q: Why is this local coop only?
A: This was a crazy feature we added by toying around with the code which started out as something that the programmers did for fun. An online mode would require reprogramming an important part of the game and is not feasible. This isn't something that was meant to be a feature of the game.

Q: Will you ever add online?
A: No. This would require remaking a substantial part of the game's code. Local coop is much more simple.

Q: How does this affect the game's story / campaign / game mechanics?
A: The game wasn't designed or balanced with coop in mind, so many things about the coop are just  things that needed to be done in a specific way in order not to break the game entirely. Player 1 still controls the main camera. Other players get to play with the character that player 1 chooses. Player 1 chooses when you can aim down (due to the camera change) ...Etc... etc. There are several obvious limitations in the coop's implementation (because the game was created strictly as a single-player experience), however the 4 player coop is hilarious and extremely fun.

We hope everyone enjoys the new content!

notes.title: Deadly Tower 1.03 update
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug where teleportation screen was freezing in some systems. ***

- Fixed performance issue for systems using NvOptimus (which have Intel and Nvidia cards in the same computer).

- Some minor fixes to Russian localization.

*** Note: The teleportation freeze issue was apparently happening mostly on machines under the minimum specs, so we had to get our hands on new hardware to be able to reproduce and find the problem. The issue was resolved on our new test machine that was experiencing the reported issue.
